2fa.title: Hive two-factor authentication
2fa.description:
Enter your Hive authentication code.

Please enter code 0000 to request another code.

error.invalid_username: Failed to sign in to Hive. Your email address is not recognized.
error.invalid_password: Failed to sign in to Hive. Incorrect password, please try again.
error.invalid_code: Failed to sign in to Hive. Your two-factor authentication code was incorrect.
error.twofa_bypassed_debug: 2FA step was intentionally bypassed for debug. Check Home Assistant logs for Hive auth responses.
error.no_internet_available: An Internet connection is required to connect to Hive.

user.title: Options for Hive
user.description: Update the scan interval to poll for data more often.

boost_heating_on.name: Boost heating on
boost_heating_on.description: Sets the boost mode ON, defining the period of time and the desired target temperature for the boost.

time_period.name: Time period
time_period.description: The time period for the boost.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The target temperature for the boost period.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: The entity ID to turn boost off.

boost_hot_water.name: Boost hotwater
boost_hot_water.description: Sets the boost mode ON or OFF, defining the period of time for the boost.

time_period.name: Time period
time_period.description: The time period for the boost.

on_off.name: Mode
on_off.description: Set the boost function on or off.

set_holiday_mode.name: Set holiday mode
set_holiday_mode.description: Schedules Hive's whole-home holiday mode, holding a frost-protection temperature for the given period.

config_entry_id.name: Hive account
config_entry_id.description: The Hive account to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

start.name: Start
start.description: When holiday mode should begin. A time without a UTC offset is read in Home Assistant's time zone.

end.name: End
end.description: When holiday mode should end. A time without a UTC offset is read in Home Assistant's time zone.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The frost-protection temperature to hold during holiday mode.

cancel_holiday_mode.name: Cancel holiday mode
cancel_holiday_mode.description: Cancels any scheduled or currently active Hive holiday mode.

config_entry_id.name: Hive account
config_entry_id.description: The Hive account to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

entry_not_found.message: No Hive account with config entry ID {entry_id} was found.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Hive account {title} is not loaded.

multiple_entries.message: More than one Hive account is set up. Choose which one to use.

end_before_start.message: The holiday mode end must be after its start.

end_in_past.message: The holiday mode end must be in the future.

reauth_required.message: Hive needs you to sign in again. Reauthenticate the integration, then try again.

set_holiday_mode_failed.message: Failed to set Hive holiday mode: {error}

set_holiday_mode_rejected.message: Hive rejected the set holiday mode request.

cancel_holiday_mode_failed.message: Failed to cancel Hive holiday mode: {error}

cancel_holiday_mode_rejected.message: Hive rejected the cancel holiday mode request.
